propositions: CLI reference syntax and options must derive entirely from registry enumeration and committed package-help bytes, verified by gen_cli_help.py --check and gen_cli_reference.py --check with byte-identical output across Python versions
Manual command census (INTERCEPT_COMMANDS, regex parsing, hand-curated route unions) must be eliminated, with all tests enumerating routes via registry attributes instead
A clean no-extras wheel must render every approved help form with exact committed bytes and no operation/config/store/parser/handler side effects
Full-extra contract must resolve every handler, parser, selector, and capability-to-extra reference without executing command logic
Editorial content must be structurally separated and lint-validated against top-level spellings, while generated syntax sections remain authoritative
The same repository-local commands must run identically in local environments and portable CI, with rebar-mcp tested as a separate entry point
